name: Help centre links
objective: Make generated help-centre links predictable. Finish the known normalization defect before taking on new features.

sources.title: Synthetic project brief
sources.content: This is a synthetic scenario, not a real connected project. Current priority: normalize pasted whitespace in link slugs. Do not change the publishing workflow or introduce dependencies. Owner review is needed before coding.

sources.title: Normalization acceptance
sources.content: The existing test covers leading/trailing whitespace and repeated spaces or hyphens. Only slug.js may change. Passing tests and a draft PR are the completion evidence. Review the outcome before choosing another feature.

spec.objective: Trim whitespace and collapse runs of spaces or hyphens in generated slugs.
spec.acceptance: Pass the existing node --test checks. Change only slug.js. Return a draft PR with exact commit and test evidence.
